cues: When cane sugar is hydrolysed, one sugar molecule reacts with one water molecule.
But water is the solvent, a vast ocean of it.
Using up a few molecules changes its concentration by almost nothing.
text: Pseudo first order. When cane sugar is hydrolysed, one sugar molecule reacts with one water molecule. Truly, that is second order. But water is the solvent, a vast ocean of it. Using up a few molecules changes its concentration by almost nothing.
